# Rachel Roberts

![](images/RachelRobertsHeadshot.jpg){width=220px fig-alt="Professional headshot of Rachel Roberts"}
:::

::: {.home-bio}
I’m a graduate research assistant at the Center for Free Enterprise at The
University of Texas at El Paso, where I conduct applied economic research
and contribute to *Economic Insights*, the center’s monthly publication.
I’m also pursuing an M.S. in Economics at UTEP and expect to graduate in
Spring 2027.

My research at the center includes an evaluation of Baltimore’s Group
Violence Reduction Strategy, which examined the program’s effect on violent
crime. I’m currently developing a forecast of Texas energy consumption that
examines how the expansion of data centers and the growing use of AI could
affect future demand.
:::

::: 

::: {.featured-research}
## Featured Research

### Evaluating Baltimore’s Group Violence Reduction Strategy

I evaluated the effect of Baltimore’s Group Violence Reduction Strategy on violent crime in the city.

### Forecasting Texas Energy Consumption

I’m developing a forecast of Texas energy consumption that examines how the growth of data centers and AI could affect future demand.
